en-US.title: Private Laravel Classes Online
en-US.subtitle: Master the Laravel framework
en-US.description: Learn Laravel, the most popular PHP framework. Build modern web applications with ease using Laravel's powerful features.
en-US.content:
## Why Laravel?

Laravel is the #1 PHP framework used by professionals worldwide. It makes web development faster, easier, and more enjoyable.

## What You'll Learn

- Laravel fundamentals and setup
- Routing and controllers
- Database migrations and Eloquent ORM
- Authentication and authorization
- Building APIs with Laravel
- Testing and deployment

## Course Modules

**Module 1**: Laravel basics, routing, and views
**Module 2**: Database design and Eloquent ORM
**Module 3**: User authentication and authorization
**Module 4**: Building REST APIs
**Module 5**: Testing and deployment

## Real Projects

Build production-ready applications:
- Complete blog platform
- Real-time chat application
- E-commerce store
- Project management tool

## Career Ready

After completing this course:
✅ You'll have production-ready projects for your portfolio
✅ You'll understand enterprise-level architecture
✅ You'll be job-ready for Laravel developer positions
✅ You'll be able to lead development teams

pt-BR.title: Aula Particular de Laravel Online
pt-BR.subtitle: Domine o framework Laravel
pt-BR.description: Aprenda Laravel, o framework PHP mais popular. Construa aplicações web modernas com facilidade usando os poderosos recursos do Laravel.
pt-BR.content:
## Por Que Laravel?

Laravel é o framework PHP #1 usado por profissionais em todo o mundo. Torna o desenvolvimento web mais rápido, fácil e agradável.

## O Que Você Aprenderá

- Fundamentos do Laravel e setup
- Routing e controllers
- Migrações de banco de dados e Eloquent ORM
- Autenticação e autorização
- Construção de APIs com Laravel
- Testes e deployment

## Módulos do Curso

**Módulo 1**: Basics, routing e views
**Módulo 2**: Design de BD e Eloquent ORM
**Módulo 3**: Autenticação e autorização
**Módulo 4**: Construção de APIs REST
**Módulo 5**: Testes e deployment

## Projetos Reais

Construa aplicações prontas para produção:
- Plataforma de blog completa
- Aplicação de chat em tempo real
- Loja de e-commerce
- Ferramenta de gerenciamento de projetos

## Pronto para Carreira

Após completar o curso:
✅ Você terá projetos prontos para produção no seu portfólio
✅ Compreenderá arquitetura de nível empresarial
✅ Estará pronto para posições de desenvolvedor Laravel
✅ Poderá liderar equipes de desenvolvimento

faqs.question: Do I need to know PHP before learning Laravel?
faqs.questionPt: Preciso saber PHP antes de aprender Laravel?
faqs.answer: It helps, but not required. We'll cover PHP essentials as part of the Laravel course.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Laravel and plain PHP?
faqs.questionPt: Qual é a diferença entre Laravel e PHP puro?
faqs.answer: Laravel provides pre-built solutions, security features, and architecture patterns that make development 10x faster than plain PHP.

faqs.question: Can I use Laravel for REST APIs?
faqs.questionPt: Posso usar Laravel para APIs REST?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Laravel is excellent for building REST APIs and we cover this extensively in the course.

faqs.question: Will I learn about databases?
faqs.answer: Yes, we cover database design, SQL basics, and Eloquent ORM for database interactions.

faqs.question: How is Laravel different from other frameworks?
faqs.questionPt: Como Laravel é diferente de outros frameworks?
faqs.answer: Laravel focuses on developer happiness with clean syntax, powerful tools, and excellent documentation. It's the most developer-friendly PHP framework.
